source: maplestory.io (GMS 270) — skillbook API + raw WZ API; class-specific 5th job skill list cross-checked against maplestorywiki.net
notes: Beginner skills from job 17000 are being fetched via the raw WZ API.

skills.name: Xuanshan Spirit
skills.description: Your vow to rebuild the Xuanshan School empowers you to live up to the legacy of your master.

skills.name: Qi Cultivation
skills.description: Cultivates your qi using techniques first developed in Jianghu, giving you the strength to challenge any enemy. The more attacks you deal to a boss, the stronger your qi becomes.

skills.name: Return to Xuanshan
skills.description: Return to the Xuanshan School.

skills.name: Xuanshan Strike [Tian]
skills.description: [Tian] [Xuanshan Form] Punches forward with a fist infused with the celestial qi of Tian, a technique of the first Xuanshan form. Tap the Xuanshan Arts [Tian] skill repeatedly to activate.

skills.name: Awaken
skills.description: Rouses the dormant power of the Divine Fist to increase your Attack Power and Critical Rate, and enhance your recovery.

skills.name: Physical Training
skills.description: Increases your Attack Power and Dexterity through rigorous physical training.

skills.name: Xuanshan Arts [Tian]
skills.description:
[Tian] [Xuanshan Form] Enhances the efficacy of Xuanshan forms aligned with the heavenly energy of Tian.

You can enhance or activate additional technique ranks through the forms acquired in later job advancements. Tap the skill key repeatedly to expand up to 2 ranks in order.

skills.name: Xuanshan Strike [Tian]
skills.description:
[Tian] [Xuanshan Form] Punches forward with a fist infused with the celestial qi of Tian, a technique of the first Xuanshan form. Tap the Xuanshan Arts [Tian] skill repeatedly to activate.
Lv. 20 required to learn Xuanshan Cross [Tian].

skills.name: Divine Art: Erupting Flame
skills.description:
[Tian] [Rank 1 Divine Art] When linked with Xuanshan Strike [Tian] after learning The Holy Mountain, your Form Link effect will increase your Final Damage.
Throws an upward punch strengthened by the power of Wu Shen, overwhelming your target with a powerful blow.

skills.name: Secret Art: Air Weaving
skills.description: Solidifies the air beneath your feet with qi, allowing you to leap great distances.

skills.name: Secret Art: Dancing Leap
skills.description: Launches you upward using techniques learned through long training.

skills.name: Xuanshan Strike [Di]
skills.description: [Di] [Xuanshan Form] Sweeps enemies ahead of you with a powerful kick that channels the earthly qi of Di, a technique of the first Xuanshan form. Tap the Xuanshan Arts [Di] skill repeatedly to activate.

skills.name: Agility Training
skills.description: Improves your flexibility and reaction time through specialized training, enhancing your Jump and Speed.

skills.name: High-Intensity Training
skills.description: Pushes your training to the limits of human capability, allowing you to face your foes with the strength of a mountain.

skills.name: Martial Mastery
skills.description: Increases Martial Brace Mastery and Attack Power.

skills.name: Secret Art: Fists of Fury
skills.description: Inflames your qi to increase your dexterity and the attack speed of the Martial Brace.

skills.name: Xuanshan Strike [Di]
skills.description:
[Di] [Xuanshan Form] Sweeps enemies ahead of you with a powerful kick that channels the earthly qi of Di, a technique of the first Xuanshan form. Tap the Xuanshan Arts [Di] skill repeatedly to activate.
Lv. 20 required to learn Xuanshan Cross [Di].

skills.name: Xuanshan Arts [Di]
skills.description:
[Di] [Xuanshan Form] Enhances the efficacy of Xuanshan forms aligned with the earthly qi of Di.

You can enhance or activate additional technique ranks through the forms acquired in later job advancements. Tap the skill key repeatedly to expand up to 2 ranks in order.

skills.name: Divine Art: Tearing Wind
skills.description:
[Di] [Rank 1 Divine Art] When linked with Xuanshan Strike [Di] after learning The Holy Mountain, your Form Link effect will increase your Final Damage.
Attacks an enemy in front with a strong side kick imbued with the power of Wu Shen.

skills.name: Secret Art: Arrow Flight
skills.description:
Launches you through the air like an arrow loosed from a bow. Moves you forward, up diagonally, or down diagonally based on the arrow keys used.
Can be used consecutively with precise control and timing.

skills.name: Martial Discipline
skills.description: Hones your qi control through intense training, making you more resilient to attack and allowing you to sense your enemy's weaknesses.

skills.name: Divine Art Training I
skills.description: Focuses the power of the Divine Fist within to enhance your Divine Arts.

skills.name: Qi Within
skills.description: Amplifies the flow of your qi throughout your body to enhance your combat capabilities and maximize your Attack Power.

skills.name: The Holy Mountain
skills.description:
Momentarily unlocks the path to the peak of Wu Shen's power, allowing you to ascend to the true heights of the Divine Fist.
Form Link: After using Xuanshan Arts [Tian]/[Di] and linking an appropriate Divine Art, the linked art will have increased Final Damage. (The Final Damage increase differs for each Divine Art.)
[Divine Fist] You'll be granted the Divine Fist effect after a successful form link. The Divine Fist effect is temporary and can be stacked up to 3 times. Mo Xuan's power increases for each stack of Divine Fist, increasing Final Damage.

skills.name: Divine Art: Righteous Thunder
skills.description:
[Tian] [Rank 1 Divine Art] When linked with Xuanshan Strike [Tian] after learning The Holy Mountain, your Form Link effect will increase your Final Damage.
Unleashes a qi shockwave that incapacitates hit enemies for a short period through the power of the
Divine Fist. Divine Art: Righteous Thunder does not share resistance with other incapacitation skills.

skills.name: Divine Art: Swirling Tide
skills.description:
[Di] [Rank 1 Divine Art] When linked with Xuanshan Strike [Di] after learning The Holy Mountain, your Form Link effect will increase your Final Damage.
Whirls with a spinning kick that damages nearby enemies. You can attack 2 times in a row by using the skill once more while spinning.

skills.name: Divine Art: Swirling Tide
skills.description:
[Di] [Rank 1 Divine Art] When linked with Xuanshan Strike [Di] after learning The Holy Mountain, your Form Link effect will increase your Final Damage.
Whirls with a spinning kick that damages nearby enemies. You can attack 2 times in a row by using the skill once more while spinning.

skills.name: Secret Art: Qi Projection
skills.description:
Projects your qi out around you, allowing you to attack nearby enemies faster than the eye can follow. When the effect is active, you will periodically pursue nearby targets. Unaffected by attack reflection.
Can be toggled On/Off
skills.note: effect (1 frames) is a blank timing sequence in the source WZ (1x1 frames); omitted.

skills.name: Secret Art: Flash Step
skills.description: Channels qi to your legs to quickly dodge backwards and evade enemy attacks.

skills.name: Aura
skills.description: Overwhelms your enemies with the sheer strength of your qi, sapping their will to fight before you've even thrown a punch.

skills.name: Boundless
skills.description: Increases Martial Brace Mastery, Attack Power, and Ignore Defense.

skills.name: Divine Art Training II
skills.description: Attunes your qi with the full strength of Wu Shen, enhancing Divine Arts.

skills.name: Heir of the Divine
skills.description:
The divine power of Wu Shen bolsters the body of his heir, rendering you nigh indestructible.
[Reincarnation]: Using a Divine Art while Reincarnation is not active will activate the Reincarnation state for 3 sec Divine Arts gain additional effects based on their [Tian] or [Di] alignment the first time they are used while Reincarnation is active.
Divine Arts that share the alignment of the previous Divine Art used will have their cooldown reduced.
Divine Arts of the opposite alignment from the previous Divine Art used will have their Final Damage increased.

[Divine Fist]: Increases the duration and max stack of the Divine Fist effect active at one time, and increases the Final Damage per stack of Divine Fist significantly.

skills.name: Xuanshan Cross [Tian]
skills.description:
[Tian] [Xuanshan Form] Follows a devastating uppercut with an unstoppable cross punch, building upon the techniques of the first Xuanshan form.
Tap the Xuanshan Arts [Tian] skill repeatedly to activate.

skills.name: Xuanshan Cross [Di]
skills.description:
[Di] [Xuanshan Form] Launches two sweeping kicks enhanced with earth qi, building upon the techniques of the first Xuanshan form.
Tap the Xuanshan Arts [Di] skill repeatedly to activate.

skills.name: Xuanshan Forms - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the damage of Xuanshan forms.

skills.name: Xuanshan Forms - Guardbreak
skills.description: Increases Ignore Defense of Xuanshan forms.

skills.name: Xuanshan Forms - Boss Rush
skills.description: Increases Boss Damage of Xuanshan forms.

skills.name: Divine Arts - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the damage of Divine Arts.

skills.name: Divine Arts - Guardbreak
skills.description: Increases the Ignore Defense of Divine Arts.

skills.name: Divine Arts - Enhance
skills.description: Enhances the Reincarnation state.

skills.name: Awaken - Efficiency
skills.description: Increases the amount healed by Awaken.

skills.name: Qi Shield - Shield Reinforce
skills.description: Strengthens your qi shield to endure more damage when hit.

skills.name: Divine Fist - Persist
skills.description: Increases the duration of the Divine Fist granted by The Holy Mountain and Heir of the Divine.

skills.name: Xuanshan Cross [Tian]

skills.name: Divine Art: Howling Storm
skills.description:
[Tian] [Rank 2 Divine Art] When linked with Xuanshan Cross [Tian] after learning The Holy Mountain, your Form Link effect will increase your Final Damage.
Lashes out with a powerful forward strike, then gathers qi to deliver a devastating final blow.
The Divine Fist released by the attack will prevent any enemies from pushing you back.

skills.name: Divine Art: Howling Storm
skills.description:

Lashes out with a powerful forward strike, then gathers qi to deliver a devastating final blow.
The Divine Fist released by the attack will prevent any enemies from pushing you back.

skills.name: Secret Art: Qi Disruption
skills.description:
Kicks out with concentrated qi that disrupts the internal energy of an enemy in front of you, stunning them. Affected enemies cannot be stunned again by Secret Art: Qi Disruption or other skills for 90 seconds.
The qi disruption pursues the enemy with the highest Max HP within range, and is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Xuanshan Cross [Tian]
skills.description:
[Tian] [Xuanshan Form] Follows a devastating uppercut with an unstoppable cross punch, building upon the techniques of the first Xuanshan form.
Tap the Xuanshan Arts [Tian] skill repeatedly to activate.

skills.name: Xuanshan Cross [Di]
skills.description:
[Di] [Xuanshan Form] Launches two sweeping kicks enhanced with earth qi, building upon the techniques of the first Xuanshan form.
Tap the Xuanshan Arts [Di] skill repeatedly to activate.

skills.name: Secret Art: Qi Shield
skills.description:
Forms a shield of qi around your body, protecting you from harm. The qi shield reduces damage taken from attacks, including attacks that inflict damage based on Max HP, but the shield gets weaker every time it is hit.
Not affected by effects which increase buff durations or Buff Freezer, and permanently decreases damage taken.

skills.name: Secret Art: Divine Fist Disciples
skills.description:
Extends the power of Wu Shen to your allies like a master guiding their disciples, temporarily granting your other party members the Divine Fist status and increasing the power of their critical attacks.
[Divine Fist] The effect is enhanced if you use the skill while you have a max stack of Divine Fist. The skill does not stack with additional uses of Divine Fist Disciple. If the skill effect is granted again while it is already active, the effect will follow the level of the most recently used skill.
Mo Xuan characters cannot receive this effect.

skills.name: Maple Warrior
skills.description: The Goddess of Maple World's grace increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Goddess of Maple World appear.

skills.name: Hero's Will
skills.description: Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through.

skills.name: Soul Art: Black Wind
skills.description: [Soul Art] Raises a whirling typhoon of dark qi from the depths of your spirit, harnessing every moment of rage and pain ever experienced by an inheritor of the Divine Fist without succumbing to the flood. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Secret Art: Strength Within
skills.description: Centers your thoughts on the present and empties your mind of doubt, instantly granting the maximum amount of Divine Fist.

skills.name: Aura of Destiny
skills.description: Embraces the powerful nature of Jianghu.

skills.name: Soul Art: Beneath Heaven
skills.description:
[Soul Art] Channels the natural qi of the world alongside the divine strength hidden within your soul, imbuing a punch with the harmonized power only you can muster.
Unaffected by attack reflection.
The Divine Fist released by the attack temporarily makes you invincible.

skills.name: Soul Art: The Conquered Self
skills.description:
[Soul Art] Breaks the twin shackles of ego and pride to temporarily transform you into the perfect instrument of balance.
Enhances Secret Art: Qi Projection while The Conquered Self is active.
Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Soul Art: The Conquered Self
skills.description:

skills.name: Soul Art: The Opened Gate
skills.description: [Soul Art] Throws open the gate of your soul, releasing the full power of Wu Shen to walk the battlefield once more. While Soul Art: The Opened Gate is active, all attacks are critical, Critical Damage increases, and Xuanshan Forms and Divine Arts are enhanced.

skills.name: Divine Art: Crashing Earth
skills.description:
[Di] [Rank 2 Divine Art] When linked with Xuanshan Cross [Di] after learning The Holy Mountain, your Form Link effect will increase your Final Damage.
Strikes the earth and explodes with the power of the Divine Fist.
